service_qualification: No new network requests/s qualification; previous mixed-write losses and stalls remain visible

test_only_clippy_repair.reason: Clippy manual_is_multiple_of in new unit-test parity predicate; equivalent expression, no runtime change.
test_only_clippy_repair.workflow_retry_note: Restricted PowerShell rejected System.IO.Path.GetFullPath; a subsequent Split-Path parameter combination was invalid. Both attempts stopped before moving or replacing logs. Native Resolve-Path and exact absolute-path checks then preserved the directory with Move-Item before rerunning checks.

preserved_development_trials: write-on-miss: useful baseline for cache stores
fused-shared-sum: rejected for wide and high-cardinality SUM regressions
typed-shared-sum: small-group benefit, not selected for wider kernels
small-cache-shared-sum: selected adaptive kernel, separately rebuilt and remeasured
sparse_reduction_policy: Only cache misses rewrite tags. At small-cache block entry, a single shared SUM/AVG column can reduce directly in the lookup loop; wider and fallback modes retain the preceding two-pass mapper.
limits: Warm single-thread queries on one shared Windows computer
Rust direct query timer versus DuckDB Python execute/fetchall; native storage layouts differ
Cache budgets and seeded exact tags are retained; small-cache block fusion changes query code without new allocations
Only DuckDB freshly compared; last multi-server matrix remains 0.3.1
No new network, cold-I/O, power-loss, distributed-scale or production qualification
